name: Eligibility or Benefit Inquiry
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/EQ) — X12 005010 EQ segment element reference, cross-checked against the HIPAA-specific 270 (005010X279A1) transaction-set guide (stedi.com/edi/edi/hipaa/transaction-set/270-B1), which places one EQ per 2110C/2110D loop instance (loop itself repeats up to 99 times — modeled maxUse='1' here, not '>1': the repetition lives at the LOOP level, matching how CLM/HL are single-occurrence-per-loop-instance segments, not at the segment level like DTP/REF/NM1 which can genuinely repeat multiple times WITHIN one loop instance). EQ02/EQ05 share the exact same C003/C004 composite shapes EB13/EQ05 (this segment) and EB's own C003 use — new for Phase 3, first transaction sets (270/271) needing this segment.
